name: cells are not inserted after Name
why: The row assembly never calls _recOfInsertCells(): headers exist, cells do not, every later column shifts.

name: _finalColNames does not count the inserted columns
why: Integer-column colIdx is resolved without them, so the positional styling lands two columns left of Length.

name: the loader never switches from browsing to lookups
why: The cost choice is gone: a 100 000-recording catalogue is paged through instead of looking up the 12 remaining rows.

name: the loader never keeps browsing
why: The cost choice always switches to lookups after the first page, even when one more page is cheaper.

name: the browse kill switch is ignored
a failed row click is taken as 'no work'
why: A transport failure becomes an answer ([]) — shown as – and cached as a fact instead of ⚠.

name: browse answers are not written to IndexedDB
why: A reload asks the Web Service again for every row.

name: a write leaves the row's cached filter text in place
why: _rowTextCache keeps the empty text read before the load, so a filter typed before loading never finds the rows.

name: the write path does not re-run an active filter
why: Caches are dropped but nothing re-filters, so the rows stay hidden until the next keystroke.

name: the toggle reads 'loaded' while a row is still loading
why: Both halves of the fix reverted: the pending count skips loading cells, and pressed ignores a running job.

name: the first fuzzy hit wins instead of the closest
why: With the decoy first in the catalogue, 'Racing in the Streets' is matched to 'Racing in the Street ’78'.

edits.find: if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = w; }
edits.replace: if (bestScore === Infinity) { bestScore = score; best = w; }

name: trailing (…) clauses are not stripped from recording titles
why: 'Prove It All Night (alternate take)' no longer matches its work.

name: the 0 % threshold still allows fuzzy matches
why: The thr > 0 gate is gone and the threshold read falls back to 25 on 0.

name: the batch-add userscript's cache is not reused
why: The work list is always requested from the Web Service.

name: the suggestions setting does not stop the work-list request

edits.find:
if (!artist || Lib.settings.sa_recording_of_suggest_enable === false) return false;
        if (_recOfWorks && _recOfWorks.artist === artist && !force) return true;
edits.replace:
if (!artist) return false;
        if (_recOfWorks && _recOfWorks.artist === artist && !force) return true;

name: the load-state matcher disagrees with its count
why: recof-state-* stops using _recOfCellLoadState(): ticking an entry matches every recording cell.

name: suggested titles are not highlighted
why: The testRowMatch() dispatch skips recofsugg: modes.

name: the suggested-work extractor drops a link it highlighted
why: Kept as a guard, recorded as not testable: the recofsugg: matcher runs on the SOURCE rows, and runFilter() highlights only the render clone, so a highlight wrapper never reaches a cell the extractor reads. Measured 2026-10-10: this mutation passes the two-entries-both-orders test. The read-through (textContent) stays so the extractor would survive a future in-place highlight.

name: our attribute column takes the third-party header's name
why: Named 'Performance Attributes' it would be stripped as the batch-add userscript's column.
